evidence: Figure 1 : Overview of CHAC. A frozen navigation policy predicts ordered waypoints from current views, visual history, and the task instruction. During execution, retained visual context and commitment checks guide when to refresh the cached prediction. At native STOP, nearby visited positions guide a bounded terminal correction without another model call. The lower scene shows how executed motion becomes visitation history. Red dots mark visited positions, and the blue disk denotes the local-history neighborhood.
